_comment: Playwright MCP config for Juno's browser agent (gateway/browser_agent.py fills in the paths per run). Headless Chromium from Playwright, its own profile under state/browser/profile, never Michael's Chrome. Page-registered tools (WebMCP) are off: a page can't hand the agent new tools. No allowedOrigins: it would also block the form's own scripts and styles from other hosts, and its README says it is no security boundary; .claude/hooks/gate_browser.py checks every navigation instead. Pinned: @playwright/mcp 0.0.85.
